nodes.name: Cognee: Add Data
nodes.notes: Community node — install from Settings → Community Nodes → n8n-nodes-cognee, then set Cognee API credentials. Verify the operation/parameter names against the installed version; they are stable but the node is young.

nodes.name: Cognee: Cognify
nodes.notes: Builds the knowledge graph: entities, relationships, chunks and embeddings. Runs once per sync, not per document.

parameters.query: Which win-back offers were sent, and how much revenue did they recover?

nodes.name: Cognee: Search (verify)
nodes.notes: A read-back assertion, not decoration: if this returns nothing, the graph did not build and the next conversation would silently lose its memory.
